sloka: ये च तत्र महात्मान ऋषयो ब्राह्मलौकिकाः ।ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाता न्यवर्तन्त महौजसः ।उत्तरं श्रोतुमनसो भविष्यं यच्च राघवे ।। ७.९८.२४ ॥
transliteration: ye ca tatra mahātmāna ṛṣayo brāhmalaukikāḥ ।brahmaṇā samanujñātā nyavartanta mahaujasaḥ ।uttaraṁ śrotumanaso bhaviṣyaṁ yacca rāghave ।। 7.98.24 ॥

translations.english: And those great-souled, greatly powerful sages from Brahma's world, who were desirous to hear the Uttara Kanda and the future events concerning Rama, returned after being permitted by Brahma.
